title: Happy alien
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antenna stalks -->
  <line x1="38" y1="30" x2="30" y2="12" stroke="#4de88a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="30" x2="70" y2="12" stroke="#4de88a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- antenna balls -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="11" r="6" fill="#ff5bef"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="11" r="3" fill="#ffd1f5"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="11" r="6" fill="#ff5bef"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="11" r="3" fill="#ffd1f5"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="30" ry="28" fill="#5be04f"/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#8cf07e"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="46" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#2b1a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="46" rx="9" ry="11" fill="#2b1a8a"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="43" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="43" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="49" r="1.8" fill="#c9c2ff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="49" r="1.8" fill="#c9c2ff"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="56" r="5" fill="#ff8fd0"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="56" r="5" fill="#ff8fd0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M38 60 Q50 72 62 60" stroke="#ffe94d" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little tongue -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff6f9e"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="20" ry="15" fill="#5be04f"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#8cf07e"/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#ffe94d"/>
  <!-- arms waving -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="82" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#5be04f" transform="rotate(-25 22 82)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="82" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#5be04f" transform="rotate(25 78 82)"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="97" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#3fbf3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="97" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#3fbf3a"/>
</svg>
